description:
The Law of Attraction by Esther Hicks is not a list of positive affirmations. This analysis follows the teachings of Abraham and shows why worry feels like it makes things worse, and how your feelings work as a compass.

We break down the book’s core ideas: feelings as guidance, contrast as signal, desire as the starting point, and allowing instead of pushing. We also take on the hardest criticism of the book, the idea that struggling people are “attracting” their pain.
